# Browser SDK provenance

Official Sentry browser bundle, version **11.4.0**.

Source: https://browser.sentry-cdn.com/11.4.0/bundle.tracing.replay.min.js

SRI (SHA-384): `sha384-rNCus5OyWgRjLeXDPCK8SLBxYJEiZScuizBvFNgaDebGSPIUbFxnnbP5j+HJCafc`

This is the official combined error/tracing/replay bundle referenced by the Sentry Session Replay installation documentation. It is kept locally so Django can serve it during the webinar. Downloaded bytes match the SRI listed in that documentation. The upstream license is included alongside this file.
